about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-87: a not_applicable grade for C2 (XC-44) and C3 (XC-45) when the caller declares the client does not sign payments (signsPayments: false) and it signs nothing, and that grade carried through every report format. On 2026-10-25 an SDK that surfaces a 402 as a typed error and has no payment path by design was graded fail on C2 ('payable offer ignored') and C3 ('never pays'). Without the declaration nothing changes: a client that never pays still fails. A client declared not to sign that signs anyway is graded as usual. Owner's go, 2026-10-25T12:48Z, in chat: 'fix mcp and endpoints and then test'. Under D-AUTO-4 sys may batch-sign contracts covered by an owner go; nothing here binds until the owner key signs it into proofline.json.

tasks.title: C2 and C3 not applicable to a client declared not to sign, shown as N/A in every report
tasks.description: Status gains not_applicable (ts/src/probe.ts, ts/src/report.ts). checkClientOfferPolicy and checkClientKeepsV2 take { signsPayments } and return status not_applicable, pass false, with a reason, when it is false and the client signed nothing. makeReport (TS and Python) excludes not_applicable from failed and lists the ids in summary.not_applicable; passed() ignores them; explain prints them as N/A. The Python report command, SARIF, JUnit (skipped, 'not applicable') and the badge treat them as not failed. The XC-44 and XC-45 criteria keep passing.

criteria.statement: C2 grades a client declared not to sign that signs nothing not_applicable, and still fails it without the declaration or when it signs a decoy anyway, on Solana devnet and Base Sepolia

verifier.cmd: o=$(mktemp) && { cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^C2 (not applicable|a client)' dist/test/*.test.js; } > "$o" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$o"; test "$rc" = 0 && node -e 'const[f,p,k]=process.argv.slice(1),re=new RegExp(p),min=+(k||1);let n=0,bad=0,cur=0;const fin=()=>{n+=cur;cur=0};for(const l of require("fs").readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n")){const m=/^ *(not )?ok \d+ - (.*)$/.exec(l);if(m){fin();if(m[1])bad++;else if(!/ # (SKIP|TODO)\b/.test(m[2])&&re.test(m[2]))cur=1;continue}if(/^ *type: .suite.$/.test(l))cur=0}fin();console.log("guard: "+n+" passing test(s) named /"+p+"/ (need "+min+"), "+bad+" not ok");process.exit(n>=min&&!bad?0:1)' "$o" '^C2 (not applicable|a client)' 6

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
